newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASKETBALL-BERLIN DO EUROLEAGUE DOUBLE OVER OLYMPIAKOS.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BERLIN DO EUROLEAGUE DOUBLE OVER OLYMPIAKOS.

text.p: Unfancied Alba Berlin produced a stunning six-point turnaround inside the last 16 seconds to defeat Greece's Olympiakos Piraeus 62-61 in Group B of the basketball Euroleague on Wednesday.
Olympiakos, the 1994 and 1995 finalists who were again one of the favourites to win this year's revamped competition, had already surprisingly succumbed to Berlin 67-64 at home in September.

After a strong second half showing, the Greek champions had turned over a 31-29 halftime deficit to lead 61-56 with just 16 seconds left on the clock when Marco Pesic was fouled in the process of scoring a three-pointer.
Knowing that the free throw could not secure the victory, Pesic threw at the ring.

Berlin grabbed the rebound and worked the ball out to their leading scorer, American Wendell Alexis, who looped the ball in from outside the three-point line to inflict Olympiakos's second defeat of the European season. Alexis scored 21 points.
Dragan Tarlac was top scorer for the Greeks with 18 points.
